asks: Where do you think it ends?
description: Somebody rendered without the pen ever coming off the paper. The line goes round the outside of them and in for the eyes and out again for the hands and never once stops, and the whole of them is that one line.
emotes: {it} moves, and the line redraws it moving without ever lifting.
{it} loops once around itself and comes out as a different posture.
{it} tightens somewhere near the middle, and the whole of it gets slightly smaller.
looks: You can follow the line from the shoe all the way to the ear without finding an end to it.
Where the line crosses itself it makes a knuckle, or a collar, or an eye.
The line is still being drawn. It is drawing the parts you already looked at.
name: a person drawn in one continuous line
says: Do not look for where it starts. That is not how this was done.
It is one stroke. It has always been one stroke.
If you pulled it, I would come undone in order.
